title: Description and Part Number must be filled to save a new part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REQ-01) exists at {Location-A}.
  • The description you will type is {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL REQUIRED).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Save without typing anything.
  3. Type three spaces in Description.
  4. Type three spaces in Part Number.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Replace the spaces in Description with {Description-A}.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Replace the spaces in Part Number with {Part-A}.
  9. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  10. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  11. Click Save.
  12. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Description is outlined in red with "Description is a required field" under it, and Part Number is outlined in red with "Part number is a required field" under it, both at the same time. The window stays open and nothing is saved. (Category and Cost may also show their own required messages, as they do today; those are not part of this check.)
  • Step 5: both messages still show: a field holding only spaces counts as empty. Nothing is saved.
  • Step 7: the Description message has gone. "Part number is a required field" still shows under Part Number, and nothing is saved.
  • Step 11: the window closes and the part is saved.
  • Step 12: one row shows {Part-A} with Description {Description-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-N1, S7-N2, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Save with nothing filled), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-N1: “Description is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Description is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • S7-N2: “Part Number is required. Left empty, or holding only spaces, the field shows "Part number is a required field" and the part is not saved.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Description field empty or only spaces): “"Description is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part Number field empty or only spaces): “"Part number is a required field" | Inline error on the field, stays until corrected”
